ca042f0e4d270f.s: How many pillars does the Digital India programme, launched by MeitY in July 2015, have?
ca042f0e4d270f.x: Digital India has three vision areas and nine pillars, not eight.

caa59bcfe324a1.s: GalaxEye's Mission Drishti was launched on a SpaceX Falcon-9 from:
caa59bcfe324a1.x: Mission Drishti was launched on a Falcon-9 from California, not Texas.

ca096a860089f4.s: In space cyber warfare, sending false signals such as fake GPS positions is called:
ca096a860089f4.x: Spoofing sends false signals such as fake GPS positions; jamming only blocks signals.

ca91971b2895b6.s: Which human-rated launch vehicle will carry India's Gaganyaan mission?
ca91971b2895b6.x: Gaganyaan uses the human-rated LVM3, not the PSLV; its Crew Escape System works during launch and ascent.

cac7ca7c584499.s: In April 2026, IIT Madras partnered with FedEx for:
o: A Centre of Excellence on Plant Cell Fermentation
India's first urban drone delivery test flights
A B.Tech programme with a tribal university
cac7ca7c584499.x: IIT Madras-FedEx was for India's first urban drone delivery test flights; the plant-cell-fermentation CoE was with Herbalife India.

ca752c198f3354.s: In low Earth orbit, only objects larger than what size are consistently tracked?
ca752c198f3354.x: Only objects larger than 10 cm in LEO are consistently tracked; the de-orbit rule is 25 years.

ca9719b9eb79ab.s: NISAR is a joint satellite mission of ISRO and:
ca9719b9eb79ab.x: NISAR is an ISRO-NASA mission, not an ISRO-ESA mission.

ca7765ac1131a2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Artemis Accords?
ca7765ac1131a2.x: Jordan became the 63rd member, not the 62nd; the Accords date to 2020 and India signed on 21 June 2023.

ca3961a18dfe78.s: Which mission of NASA's Artemis programme is the crewed lunar flyby?
ca3961a18dfe78.x: Artemis II is the crewed flyby; Artemis I was the uncrewed Orion mission and Artemis III is planned as a landing.

ca9dd8149b01d8.s: Excess sugar in the diet favours the growth of which gut microorganisms?
ca9dd8149b01d8.x: Sugar favours E. coli and Candida and reduces Bifidobacteria and Lactobacilli.

ca0c3f3064cd57.s: India's two Defence Industrial Corridors are in:
ca0c3f3064cd57.x: The Defence Industrial Corridors are in Uttar Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, not Gujarat.

ca0cf16bfc9d14.s: Which of the following causes space weather?
ca0cf16bfc9d14.x: Coronal mass ejections cause space weather; auroras are only seen near the poles, and the magnetosphere deflects the solar wind.

ca861889f0e919.s: Stage III of India's three-stage nuclear programme is based on:
o: Thorium reactors converting Th-232 to U-233
Boiling water reactors using enriched uranium
ca861889f0e919.x: Stage III uses thorium reactors (Th-232 to U-233); Stage I uses PHWRs and Stage II FBRs with MOX fuel.

ca20abf7232d27.s: The 'Framework for Action' for MSTEC training (February 2026) was produced by:
ca20abf7232d27.x: ISA and IIT Delhi produced the Framework for Action; IIT Indore made the MICP bio-shield and IIT Jodhpur the health sensors.

ca3087379e2215.s: The Galileo satellite navigation system belongs to:
ca3087379e2215.x: Galileo is the EU's system; BeiDou is China's, GLONASS Russia's and GPS the USA's.

cadc2631060a7d.s: Iran's Arman BMD air-defence system is designed to counter:
o: Cruise missiles and jets as a mobile system
Short/medium-range ballistic missiles, using a 360-degree radar
cadc2631060a7d.x: Arman BMD counters short/medium-range ballistic missiles with a 360-degree radar; Tor-M1 targets precision-guided bombs and Bavar-373 is the long-range system.

ca109f91002488.s: Which of the following about India's defence sector is NOT correct?
o: Operation Sadbhavana comprises Army welfare operations in remote areas
The Strategic Partnership Model links public sector firms with foreign OEMs
FDI in defence is allowed up to 74% via the automatic route (2020)
DPSUs account for over 70% of defence manufacturing
ca109f91002488.x: The Strategic Partnership Model links private firms, not public firms, with foreign OEMs.

ca848aaa94ab47.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the SHANTI Act, 2025?
o: It allows private companies, JVs and foreign entities to build and operate nuclear plants
It gives statutory status to the AERB
It replaces the Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage Act, 2010
ca848aaa94ab47.x: The SHANTI Act removes supplier liability and makes the operator solely liable.

cacfafec694ed9.s: The DPEPP 2020 set a defence export target for 2025 of:
cacfafec694ed9.x: The DPEPP 2020 target was Rs 35,000 crore by 2025; Rs 38,424 crore is the actual export figure of 2025-26.

cafa6a82fafce3.s: Regional satellite navigation systems such as NavIC use:
o: Medium Earth orbit at about 20,000 km
Low Earth orbit at about 400 km
Medium Earth orbit at about 35,000 km
cafa6a82fafce3.x: Regional systems use geosynchronous orbits at about 35,000 km; global systems such as GPS use MEO at about 20,000 km.

cae8fc10f5d227.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Project NETRA and space situational awareness?
o: NETRA's optical telescope tracks space debris
The Indian Space Situational Awareness initiative dates to 2019
Hanle is India's first dark sky reserve
NETRA's debris-tracking optical telescope is at Mahabaleshwar
cae8fc10f5d227.x: NETRA's optical telescope is at Hanle, Ladakh; Mahabaleshwar hosts an X-band Doppler weather radar.

ca96cc98b17b96.s: Sanshodhak, built by GRSE, is a:
ca96cc98b17b96.x: Sanshodhak is a survey ship; Dunagiri is a P-17A frigate, Aridaman an SSBN and Agre an ASW craft.

ca47207fba63a7.s: Which of the following about INS Malvan and the Large Cavitation Tunnel is NOT correct?
o: INS Malvan was built by Cochin Shipyard
INS Malvan belongs to an eight-ship ASW-SWC project
The Large Cavitation Tunnel is at NSTL, Visakhapatnam
Construction of the Large Cavitation Tunnel was inaugurated by the Chief of the Air Staff
ca47207fba63a7.x: The tunnel's construction was inaugurated by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh; INS Malvan is the second ASW-SWC by Cochin Shipyard.

ca53b93716fa37.s: The C-NOBAR compact green noise barrier was developed by:
ca53b93716fa37.x: C-NOBAR was developed by CSIR-NEERI, Nagpur, established in 1958.

ca2f8476a33563.s: CSIR-NCL, which worked on scaling Dimethyl Ether fuel, is located in:
ca2f8476a33563.x: CSIR-NCL is in Pune, not Hyderabad.

ca7036ea451f98.s: Mausam Vani, which gives AI-powered weather information in regional languages, was developed by:
ca7036ea451f98.x: Mausam Vani was developed by IITM, Pune and gives weather information in regional languages, not only English.

caa9ff42f2811c.s: Exercise IN-SLN DIVEX is conducted by India with:
caa9ff42f2811c.x: IN-SLN DIVEX is with Sri Lanka; Cyclone-IV is with Egypt, DUSTLIK with Uzbekistan and SINBOX with Cambodia.

ca4ea7d4572039.s: Which of the following about air-defence radars is NOT correct?
o: Older Patriot radars scanned a 360-degree cone
Cheongung II fires through 360 degrees via a Vertical Launch System
Cheongung II uses a rotating multi-function radar
ca4ea7d4572039.x: Older Patriot radars scanned only a 120-degree cone; the other statements about Cheongung II are correct.

cae6b2a81e3852.s: Which of the following about Progerinin and shigellosis is NOT correct?
o: Progerinin is a therapy for progeria
Shigellosis spreads through contaminated food and water
PRG S&T, co-developer of Progerinin, is a North Korean firm
cae6b2a81e3852.x: Sentinel Therapeutics and PRG S&T are South Korean, not North Korean.

ca3eac134d0315.s: The New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact (February 2026) was backed by India and how many countries or organisations?
ca3eac134d0315.x: The declaration, inspired by 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam', was backed by India and 88 countries or organisations.

ca9388f2111527.s: BharatGen, India's sovereign generative AI initiative, is meant to cover how many scheduled languages?
ca9388f2111527.x: BharatGen has reached 15 languages and is meant to cover all 22 scheduled languages.

cac0e7381aa095.s: A solar cycle, during which the Sun's magnetic poles flip, lasts about:
cac0e7381aa095.x: A solar cycle lasts about 11 years and includes a reversal of the Sun's magnetic poles; IIT Kanpur developed a method to predict it.

ca0e3e8948d954.s: India consumes about what share of the world's microprocessors?
ca0e3e8948d954.x: India consumes about 20% of the world's microprocessors.

ca6ca53fa3c81c.s: INS Anjadeep, the Anti-Submarine Warfare ship commissioned at Chennai Port, was built by:
ca6ca53fa3c81c.x: INS Anjadeep was built by GRSE, Kolkata, and carries the Abhay sonar for its ASW role.

ca41a26253eb8b.s: Mundra, India's largest private port, is located on the:
ca41a26253eb8b.x: Mundra is on the Gulf of Kutch on the west coast, not the east coast.

ca852e3628f88b.s: The Indian Army declared 2026 as the:
ca852e3628f88b.x: Army Chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi declared 2026 the 'Year of Networking & Data Centricity'.

ca17358da79bdc.s: How many tRNA genes do human cells have?
ca17358da79bdc.x: Human cells have 418 tRNA genes, of which 4 were identified as promising for PERT.

cadca0074e5ff7.s: Which of the following about the MAPS UAV and the MPATGM is NOT correct?
o: The MPATGM is a third-generation man-portable anti-tank guided missile
The Army placed an order worth Rs 186 crore for the MAPS UAV
The MPATGM was tested at KK Ranges, Ahilyanagar
The MAPS UAV is the Army's first fully solar-powered UAV
cadca0074e5ff7.x: The MAPS UAV order was worth Rs 168 crore, not Rs 186 crore.

cadbe0e1501886.s: DIME, the logistics platform launched in January 2026, is notable as the:
cadbe0e1501886.x: DIME (Depot Integration Management Edition) was the first end-to-end logistics integration.

cab48f32b237df.s: The improved third stage (SS3) of the SSLV qualified for flight after a static ground test lasting:
cab48f32b237df.x: All parameters of the 108-second test matched and the improved SS3 was qualified for flight missions.

cac3fa092e0d4c.s: The Qualcomm chip unveiled by Ashwini Vaishnaw in Bengaluru was built on which node?
cac3fa092e0d4c.x: The chip unveiled was a 2-nanometre chip, not a 3-nanometre one.

ca366c67fddc61.s: DHRUV64 was which chip fabricated under the Digital India RISC-V (DIR-V) Programme?
ca366c67fddc61.x: DHRUV64, based on open-source RISC-V, was the third chip under the DIR-V Programme.

ca8205c48c4feb.s: Which of the following about lenacapavir is NOT correct?
o: Zimbabwe began its rollout on 19 February 2025 at Epworth
It is meant only for HIV-negative persons
ca8205c48c4feb.x: Zimbabwe's rollout began on 19 February 2026, not 2025.

ca3ed2caac52ea.s: India's Universal Immunisation Programme, under which the indigenous tetanus and Td vaccines were launched, began in:
ca3ed2caac52ea.x: The UIP dates to 1985; 1905 is the year CRI Kasauli was established.

ca9647fc8d385c.s: Under the Drone Rules 2021, the number of approvals was reduced from 72 to:
ca9647fc8d385c.x: Approvals were cut from 72 to 4, while forms were cut from 25 to 5.

ca39418e60fd6f.s: PATH-GENI, a freely available software tool, is used for studying:
o: Ligand unbinding pathways and drug residence time
ca39418e60fd6f.x: PATH-GENI studies ligand unbinding pathways and drug residence time.

ca64131f3430a3.s: The payload capacity of the Heron Mk II UAV is up to:
ca64131f3430a3.x: The Heron Mk II can carry up to 500 kg, not 50 kg.

caecd88417f9d1.s: India's rare-earth reserves (as REO) are about:
caecd88417f9d1.x: India has about 6.9 million tonnes; China has 44 and Brazil 21.

ca1b4b8a7c70c9.s: Which rare-earth elements are used in phosphors for LEDs and flat-screen displays?
ca1b4b8a7c70c9.x: Europium, terbium and yttrium are used in phosphors; lanthanum and cerium go into refining catalysts.

caad241cea77fa.s: The brain-data law on neurotechnology (2024) was enacted by:
caad241cea77fa.x: California has the brain-data law; China has the China Brain Project and Chile amended its Constitution for mental integrity.

ca388bcfef0c30.s: The Biosecurity Law (2021) was enacted by:
ca388bcfef0c30.x: China has the Biosecurity Law (2021); Australia has the Biosecurity Act (2015) and the EU the Health Security Framework (2022).

ca9182f9fdc2e9.s: BSNL's nationwide Voice over WiFi rollout on 1 January 2026 was based on:
ca9182f9fdc2e9.x: BSNL's VoWiFi rollout was IMS-based, not circuit-switched; it was free across all circles.

caad50ef997fc0.s: EEG headsets are an example of which type of brain-computer interface?
caad50ef997fc0.x: EEG headsets are non-invasive BCIs; invasive BCIs use implanted electrodes.

ca92625361a8cd.s: Which mobile generation was launched during 2009-2012?
ca92625361a8cd.x: 4G was launched in 2009-2012; 5G came from 2019 onwards and 6G is expected in 2030+.

ca9b1991d4e1b7.s: In February 2025, OpenAI's Sam Altman described India as OpenAI's ____ market by users.
ca9b1991d4e1b7.x: OpenAI identified India as its second-largest market by users, not the largest.

cabc25e4e83a6e.s: The ESA-NASA Solar Orbiter was launched in:
cabc25e4e83a6e.x: Solar Orbiter was launched in February 2020; Parker Solar Probe dates to 2018 and Aditya-L1 to 2023.

ca933ec0409080.s: How many MH-60R helicopters has India procured from the US?
ca933ec0409080.x: India procured 24 MH-60R helicopters; 145 is the number of M777 howitzers and 31 of MQ-9B drones.

cac896798274dd.s: Which of the following about the UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance is NOT correct?
o: Its session in Geneva is scheduled for July 2026
A session in New York is scheduled for 2027
The UN Secretary-General called it a 'groundbreaking milestone'
It was launched by the UN General Assembly
cac896798274dd.x: Antonio Guterres called it a 'pathbreaking milestone', not a 'groundbreaking' one.

ca34a022a819ac.s: The Centralised Command and Control Centre of the Integrated Air Defence Weapon System (IADWS) was developed by:
ca34a022a819ac.x: DRDL provided the Command and Control Centre; IADWS is fully indigenous and was not developed with Israel's Rafael.

ca682c6f0e37d8.s: Which of the following about AI and news copyright is NOT correct?
o: Fair use requires compensation to be paid to publishers
Large language models have been trained on news content without consent or compensation
In India, DPIIT formed a committee on copyright and AI
Australia and Canada have laws making tech giants pay news publishers
ca682c6f0e37d8.x: Fair use allows limited use without permission and does not require payment.

ca609503d57b9a.s: INS Tamal, commissioned in Russia on 1 July 2025, has about what indigenous content?
ca609503d57b9a.x: INS Tamal has 26% indigenous content with over 33 Made-in-India systems; about 75% is the Project 17A figure.

ca9f49efc63a17.s: India's 2001 fleet review was held at:
ca9f49efc63a17.x: The 2001 review was at Mumbai; the 2006, 2016 and 2022 reviews were at Visakhapatnam.

caf2454bf4884a.s: Which of the following about IASV Triveni is NOT correct?
o: It began the first-ever tri-service all-women sailing circumnavigation
It was built at Goa Shipyard
It is to return to Mumbai by May 2026
caf2454bf4884a.x: IASV Triveni was built at the Indian Naval Dockyard, Puducherry, not at Goa.

cafddedd35ac7f.s: How many women officers made up the crew of IASV Triveni?
cafddedd35ac7f.x: The crew had 10 women officers: 5 Army, 1 Navy and 4 Air Force.

ca9409f4fe1420.s: Under Project 75, MDL earlier built which class of submarine with France?
ca9409f4fe1420.x: MDL built the Scorpene class with France; Types 214 and 218 are TKMS submarines.

cae157de680517.s: The short-range layer of India's air defence comprises:
cae157de680517.x: QRSAM and Spyder form the short-range layer; VSHORADS and MANPADS are the very-short-range layer.

cae8fc38595331.s: In the Konkan-25 carrier strike group exercise, which aircraft was a UK asset?
cae8fc38595331.x: The F-35B flew from HMS Prince of Wales; MiG-29K, Kamov-31 and LCA-Navy were on INS Vikrant.

ca357c428ae419.s: MILAN, the biennial multilateral naval exercise, is conducted under the:
ca357c428ae419.x: MILAN is run by the Eastern Naval Command, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, which is why MILAN 2026 is held there.

cab933fcfe97fd.s: India's only commercial GM crop is:
cab933fcfe97fd.x: Bt cotton is India's only commercial GM crop; genome editing changes an organism's own genes without foreign DNA.

cab7f05f00eda6.s: Mounjaro and Zepbound are brand names of:
cab7f05f00eda6.x: Tirzepatide is sold as Mounjaro and Zepbound; semaglutide is sold as Ozempic and Wegovy.

cad5bc89ddaaa0.s: India's second National Space Day was observed on:
cad5bc89ddaaa0.x: The second National Space Day was on 23 August 2025, marking the Chandrayaan-3 landing.

ca8efa08b2b48e.s: Under 'fair use' in the AI-and-news copyright debate, content may be used without permission:
o: Only to a limited extent, with no mandatory compensation
Without any limit and without compensation
Only to a limited extent, with mandatory compensation
ca8efa08b2b48e.x: Fair use permits only limited use without permission and does not mandate compensation.

new.s: Which blood group is the universal donor of red cells?
new.x: O negative red cells carry no A, B or Rh(D) antigens, so they can be given to anyone.

new.s: Which blood group is the universal recipient?
new.x: AB positive blood has no anti-A, anti-B or anti-Rh antibodies, so it can receive any group.

new.s: For plasma transfusion, the universal donor group is:
new.x: AB plasma has no anti-A or anti-B antibodies; for plasma the roles reverse compared with red cells.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Rh factor:
1. Blood with the Rh protein is Rh-positive.
2. Giving Rh-positive blood to an Rh-negative person can cause sensitisation.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: the Rh protein makes blood Rh-positive, and Rh+ blood given to an Rh- person can sensitise the recipient.

new.s: The 108th Indian Science Congress, the last session held, took place at:
new.x: The 108th Indian Science Congress was held at Nagpur; the 109th at LPU was put on hold.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 109th Indian Science Congress:
1. It was to be hosted by Lovely Professional University, Punjab.
2. It was held as scheduled in January 2024.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: LPU was to host it from 3 January 2024, but the session was put on hold after LPU withdrew.

new.s: Shigella, which caused the shigellosis outbreak in Kerala, is a:
new.x: Shigella is a Gram-negative, non-motile rod-shaped bacterium spread through contaminated food and water.

new.s: The first-ever World Health Assembly resolution recognising it as a major public health emergency concerned:
new.x: The WHA adopted its first-ever resolution recognising stroke as a major public health emergency.

new.s: The Semicon India Programme, launched in December 2021, has an outlay of:
new.x: The Semicon India Programme has Rs 76,000 crore for fabs, display fabs and design projects.

new.s: The IndiaAI Mission has an outlay of:
new.x: The IndiaAI Mission has Rs 10,300 crore; Rs 76,000 crore is the Semicon India Programme.

new.s: The Design Linked Incentive (DLI) scheme under the India Semiconductor Mission supports:
o: Chip design startups and fabless companies
new.x: The DLI scheme supports chip design startups and fabless companies.

new.s: India's first State-led Space Technology Centre of Excellence was set up in:
new.x: The Karnataka Space Tech CoE in Bengaluru is India's first State-led Space Technology Centre of Excellence.

new.s: India's first integrated CCUS Field Lab of IIT Bombay carried out the first scientific drilling for CO2 storage in the:
new.x: The IIT Bombay CCUS Field Lab did the first scientific drilling for CO2 storage in the Deccan Traps.

new.s: Mahendragiri, delivered by MDL on 30 April 2026, is which Project 17A frigate overall?
new.x: Mahendragiri is the sixth Project 17A frigate and the fourth built at MDL.

new.s: Tarapur Units 1 and 2, India's first commercial nuclear reactors, are:
new.x: Tarapur 1 and 2 are boiling water reactors commissioned in 1969; Stage I of the programme uses PHWRs.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor at Kalpakkam?
o: It has a capacity of 500 MW
It uses liquid sodium as coolant
It uses a moderator to slow down neutrons
new.x: A fast breeder reactor uses fast neutrons and no moderator; the PFBR is 500 MW, sodium-cooled and built by BHAVINI.

new.s: GAGAN, India's satellite-based augmentation system, was developed by ISRO with:
new.x: GAGAN is by ISRO and the Airports Authority of India, and it is not limited to aviation.

new.s: Aditya-L1 reached Lagrange Point L1, about 1.5 million km away, after a journey of about:
new.x: Aditya-L1's journey took about 125 days, against about 300 days for the Mars Orbiter Mission.

new.s: Coartem Baby (artemether-lumefantrine), which received WHO prequalification, is a:
o: Malaria drug for newborns and infants
Gene therapy for sickle cell disease
new.x: Coartem Baby is a malaria drug for newborns and infants; R78C is the malaria vaccine.

new.s: India's first subcutaneous immunotherapy, Tecentriq SC (Atezolizumab), is from:
new.x: Tecentriq SC, for non-small cell lung cancer, is from Roche; Eli Lilly makes Lormalsy.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: CAIR, Bengaluru – Mountain radars for the IAF
LRDE – Prajna AI satellite imaging system
VRDE, Ahilyanagar – Two new military vehicles
new.x: VRDE developed the two military vehicles; Prajna is by CAIR, the mountain radars were designed by LRDE and the scramjet combustor by DRDL.

new.s: SMILE, the joint mission of ESA and the Chinese Academy of Sciences, was launched on 19 May 2026 aboard:
new.x: SMILE was launched on Vega-C from Europe's Spaceport in French Guiana.

new.s: IMD's first AI-based block-level monsoon forecast covers how many blocks?
new.x: The forecast covers 3,196 blocks in 15 States and 1 UT of the monsoon core zone.

new.s: The two mountain radars ordered for the IAF in March 2026 were contracted to BEL for:
new.x: BEL got a Rs 1,950 crore contract for two LRDE-designed mountain radars.

new.s: The theme of the 108th Indian Science Congress at Nagpur was:
o: Science and Technology for Sustainable Development with Women Empowerment
Science and Technology for Rural Development
new.x: The 108th session at Nagpur had the theme 'Science and Technology for Sustainable Development with Women Empowerment'.

new.s: The 109th Indian Science Congress, put on hold, was to be hosted by:
new.x: LPU, Punjab was to host it from 3 January 2024, but withdrew and the session was put on hold.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Indian Science Congress:
1. The 108th session was held at Nagpur.
2. The Department of Science and Technology froze its sponsorship.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: the 108th session was at Nagpur, and DST froze sponsorship accusing ISCA of 'unilateral decisions'.

new.s: O negative is the universal donor of red cells because its red cells lack:
new.x: O negative red cells carry no A, B or Rh(D) antigens.

new.s: AB positive is the universal recipient because its plasma lacks:
new.x: AB positive blood has no anti-A, anti-B or anti-Rh antibodies, so it can receive red cells of any group.

new.s: Which blood group is the universal plasma donor?
new.x: AB plasma has no anti-A or anti-B antibodies; for plasma the donor role reverses from O to AB.

new.s: Kyasanur Forest Disease is transmitted mainly by:
new.x: KFD spreads through the tick Haemaphysalis spinigera and monkeys; it does not spread person to person.

new.s: Tattooing can transmit which of the following?
new.x: Tattooing can transmit Hepatitis B and HIV, but not Chikungunya.

new.s: AZT (zidovudine, 1987), the first HIV drug, targeted the viral:
new.x: AZT targeted reverse transcriptase; lenacapavir is the first capsid-based HIV inhibitor.

new.s: India's first indigenous MRI scanner was developed by:
new.x: Voxel Grids Innovations, Bengaluru, made the first indigenous MRI scanner with BIRAC funding; Levim made the Liraglutide biosimilar.

new.s: Which processor-developer pair is correctly matched?
new.x: VEGA is C-DAC's; SHAKTI is from IIT Madras, VIKRAM from ISRO-SCL and AJIT from IIT Bombay with SAMEER.

new.s: The AJIT processor (2018), meant for industrial and robotics use, was developed by:
new.x: AJIT is from IIT Bombay with SAMEER; SHAKTI is from IIT Madras.

new.s: Which of the following is a rare-earth element?
new.x: Yttrium is a rare-earth element; lithium, cobalt and gallium are critical minerals, not REEs.

new.s: How many elements are classed as rare-earth elements?
new.x: The 17 REEs are the 15 lanthanides plus scandium and yttrium.

new.s: The SVAMITVA scheme uses drones to map:
new.x: SVAMITVA (April 2020) maps rural abadi areas, not urban areas, with the Survey of India.

new.s: The three-stage, all-solid SSLV can place up to about how much payload in low Earth orbit?
new.x: The SSLV carries up to about 500 kg to LEO; its SS3 stage gives up to 4 km/s.

new.s: How many satellites were lost in the PSLV-C62 (EOS-N1) failure of 12 January 2026?
new.x: A third-stage anomaly caused the loss of all 15 satellites: 7 Indian and 8 foreign.

new.s: MILAN 2026 at Visakhapatnam was which edition of the exercise?
new.x: MILAN 2026 was the 13th edition and the largest ever, with 74 countries.

new.s: How many members does the Indian Ocean Naval Symposium (IONS) have?
new.x: IONS, set up in 2008, has 25 members; India chairs it for 2025-27.

new.s: India's defence budget for 2026-27 is:
new.x: The defence budget for 2026-27 is Rs 7.85 lakh crore; Rs 3.60 lakh crore is the 114-Rafale approval.

new.s: The Deep Ocean Mission (2021, Rs 4,077 crore), under which Matsya-6000 is built, belongs to the:
o: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
new.x: The Deep Ocean Mission is under the Ministry of Earth Sciences; Matsya-6000 is built at NIOT Chennai.

new.s: Matsya-6000 is designed to carry how many aquanauts to 6,000 m?
new.x: Matsya-6000 carries 3 aquanauts for 12 hours, with 96 hours of emergency endurance.

new.s: Agni Pariksha was the first joint exercise of the Indian Army with the:
new.x: Agni Pariksha in Arunachal Pradesh was the first joint exercise of the Army's Spear Corps with ITBP.

new.s: Which of the following about the India-AI Impact Summit 2026 is NOT correct?
o: It was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi
It was the first global AI summit hosted in the Global South
Its theme was 'Sarvajan Hitaya, Sarvajan Sukhaya'
It was organised by NITI Aayog
new.x: The Summit was organised by MeitY with the IndiaAI Mission, not NITI Aayog.

new.s: In the BioE3 Policy (August 2024), 'E3' stands for:
new.x: BioE3 is Biotechnology for Economy, Environment and Employment, focused on biomanufacturing.

new.s: With the National Environmental Standards Laboratory at CSIR-NPL, India became second after which country to have one?
new.x: India is second after the UK to have such a laboratory for calibrating pollution monitors.

new.s: Where was the 108th Indian Science Congress held?
new.x: The 108th session, the last one held, was at Nagpur.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 109th Indian Science Congress:
1. It was put on hold after Lovely Professional University withdrew as host.
2. The Department of Science and Technology froze its sponsorship.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: LPU withdrew and DST froze sponsorship, accusing ISCA of 'unilateral decisions'.

new.s: A person with which blood group can receive red cells of any group?
new.x: AB positive is the universal recipient: it has no anti-A, anti-B or anti-Rh antibodies.

new.s: Red cells of which blood group can be given to a patient of any group?
new.x: O negative is the universal red-cell donor because it lacks A, B and Rh(D) antigens.

new.s: A person is classed as Rh-negative when the red cells:
o: Lack both A and B antigens
Carry both A and B antigens
new.x: Rh-negative means the Rh protein is absent; Rh-positive blood given to such a person can cause sensitisation.

new.s: Before Shubhanshu Shukla, the last Indian in space was Rakesh Sharma, who flew in 1984 aboard:
new.x: Rakesh Sharma flew on Soyuz T-11 in 1984, 40 years before Shukla's Axiom-4 flight.

new.s: How many ISRO-selected microgravity experiments were conducted on the Axiom-4 mission?
new.x: India conducted 7 ISRO-selected microgravity experiments; Axiom-4 overall had 60 studies from 31 countries.

new.s: INS Udaygiri, commissioned on 26 August 2025, is named after a mountain range in:
new.x: Udaygiri is named after a mountain range in Andhra Pradesh; Himgiri is named after the Himalayas.

new.s: INS Udaygiri is the ____ ship designed by the Navy's Warship Design Bureau.
new.x: Udaygiri is the 100th ship designed by the Warship Design Bureau.

new.s: Project 75(I), for which MDL began talks with TKMS, involves how many conventional submarines with AIP?
new.x: Project 75(I) is for six conventional submarines with Air-Independent Propulsion, not nuclear ones.

new.s: India's first indigenous fifth-generation stealth fighter, AMCA, is being developed by:
new.x: AMCA is by the Aeronautical Development Agency of DRDO; Safran co-develops the 120 kN engine for AMCA Mk-2.

new.s: Which India-US foundational pact-year pair is correctly matched?
new.x: LEMOA is from 2016; COMCASA is 2018, BECA 2020 and SOSA 2024.

new.s: In its maiden flight tests, how many targets did the IADWS destroy simultaneously?
new.x: IADWS destroyed three targets at once: two fixed-wing UAVs and one multi-copter drone.

new.s: At the 2024 IADC meet hosted by India, India pledged 'Debris-Free Space Missions' by:
new.x: India pledged Debris-Free Space Missions by 2030 at the 2024 IADC meet.

new.s: India's programme for about 52 surveillance satellites from 2026 is worth about:
new.x: The surveillance-satellite programme is worth about Rs 27,000 crore.

new.s: The 6G vision targets peak speeds of about:
new.x: 6G aims at about 1 Tbps; 10-20 Gbps is the 5G peak and 100 Mbps the 4G mobile peak.

new.s: Before AI enters the curriculum from Class 3, CBSE already offers AI as a skill subject from Class:
new.x: CBSE offers AI as a skill subject from Class 6; AI from Class 3 starts in 2026-27.

new.s: India's first indigenous CAR-T therapy for blood cancer, approved by CDSCO in 2023, is:
new.x: NexCAR19 is India's first indigenous CAR-T therapy; InCART is the IIT Bombay-Tata Memorial platform and BIRSA 101 a CRISPR therapy.

new.s: AdFalciVax, India's first indigenous multi-stage malaria vaccine, targets:
new.x: AdFalciVax is a recombinant chimeric vaccine against Plasmodium falciparum, acting before the parasite enters the bloodstream.

new.s: Which spacecraft was the first to image the Sun's poles?
new.x: The ESA-NASA Solar Orbiter was the first to image the Sun's poles; Parker Solar Probe made the closest approach.

new.s: Exercise Yudh Abhyas 2025 between India and the US was which edition?
new.x: Yudh Abhyas 2025 at Fort Wainwright, Alaska was the 21st edition; the series began in 2004.

new.s: In the IISc study on Asgard archaea, which protein is the hallmark of eukaryotes?
new.x: Tubulin is the eukaryotic hallmark; FtsZ is the bacterial division protein forming the Z-ring.
